_why: Row 2729 interpreter half: GREEN's `--check-anchors` line is emitted with an interpreter the Phase-5 gate admits, not the pytest-capable `--python` the gate may refuse. Each mutant restores the refused command, keeps an interpreter the gate refuses, or substitutes one that cannot run.

mutations.name: A1: CALL SITE USES --python. The pre-fix prompt: the gate refuses the anchor check under /opt/anaconda3.
A2: ALWAYS KEEP. Every --python is treated as trusted, so an untrusted one is never substituted.
A3: NEVER KEEP. A trusted --python is swapped for another, so prompts stop being byte-identical.
A4: VENV DROPPED. A project .venv interpreter the gate admits is replaced by a system one.
mutations.find: if _contained_venv_executable(python, project_root, None) is not None:  # M:AT-ANCHOR-VENV

mutations.name: A5: NAME-ONLY VENV. Any `.venv/bin/python` is kept, including one outside the root that the gate refuses.
mutations.find: if _contained_venv_executable(python, project_root, None) is not None:  # M:AT-ANCHOR-VENV

mutations.name: A6: UNPROBED CANDIDATE. The first candidate is taken unrun, so GREEN is told to run an absent interpreter or an install-prompt stub.
A7: NO FALLBACK. With nothing runnable, a missing candidate is emitted instead of --python.
